import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); fz = repo / 'target/debug/fz'

def write_project(name, source):
    root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'fozzylang-{name}-'))
    (root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text(textwrap.dedent(f'''\
        [package]
        name="{name}"
        version="0.1.0"

        [[target.bin]]
        name="{name}"
        path="src/main.fzy"
    '''))
    (root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text(textwrap.dedent(source))
    return root

bad = write_project('memory_phase_bad', '''
    use core.mem;
    fn main() -> i32 {
        mem.freeze()
        let p = alloc(8)
        free(p)
        return 0
    }
''')
bad_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'build', str(bad), '--strict', '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
bad_payload = json.loads(bad_proc.stdout.strip())
assert bad_proc.returncode == 1, (bad_proc.returncode, bad_payload, bad_proc.stderr)
assert any('allocation `alloc` after `mem.freeze()`' in item['message'] for item in bad_payload['items']), bad_payload
memory_report = json.loads((bad / '.fz' / 'memory-report.json').read_text())
main_phase = next(item for item in memory_report['freeze_phases'] if item['function'] == 'main')
assert main_phase['entryUnfrozen']['allocWhileFrozen'] is True, main_phase
assert any(item['kind'] == 'freeze_phase' for item in memory_report['violations']), memory_report

ok = write_project('memory_phase_ok', '''
    use core.mem;
    fn main() -> i32 {
        mem.freeze()
        mem.unfreeze()
        let p = alloc(8)
        free(p)
        return 0
    }
''')
ok_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'build', str(ok), '--strict', '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
ok_payload = json.loads(ok_proc.stdout.strip())
assert ok_proc.returncode == 0, (ok_proc.returncode, ok_payload, ok_proc.stderr)
contracts = json.loads((ok / '.fz' / 'native-runtime-contracts.json').read_text())
by_callee = {item['callee']: item for item in contracts['imports']}
assert by_callee['mem.freeze']['requiredCapability'] == 'mem', by_callee['mem.freeze']
assert by_callee['mem.unfreeze']['requiredCapability'] == 'mem', by_callee['mem.unfreeze']
print('compiler-memory-phase-freeze-ok')
